test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the statement that most appropriately sums up the passage given.

options.text: Some people cannot be identified due to their most effective ways in 25 years.
Research grants in an organisation should be increased for personal excellence.
It takes 25 years of research to make people more effective and influential.
Some people are more effective and more influential than others to get things done.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Some people are more effective and more influential than others to get things done.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The statement that most appropriately sums up the passage is: **Some people are more effective and more influential than others to get things done. **
 
• Explanation: This **statement accurately captures the main idea of the passage,** which discusses the research conducted **over 25 years to identify individuals **within **organizations** who are **exceptionally effective and influential in getting things done.** The passage highlights the efforts made to understand and learn from these highly effective colleagues.
 
• Why other options can't be the answer:
 
 
• ***"Some people cannot be identified due to their most effective ways in 25 years": ***This statement does not reflect the content of the passage, which is focused on identifying highly effective individuals rather than the inability to identify them.
 
• ***"Research grants in an organisation should be increased for personal excellence":*** This statement introduces a new topic not addressed in the passage, namely, increasing research grants for personal excellence, and does not reflect the main idea.
 
• ***"It takes 25 years of research to make people more effective and influential":*** This statement inaccurately suggests that the research aimed to make people more effective and influential, whereas the passage discusses identifying individuals who are already highly effective and influential.
